purpose: Test whether DeepSeek V4 Pro materially improves on the completed DeepSeek V4 Flash value candidate while preserving the same pragmatic correction contract and safety gates.

stages.decision: Complete repeat one unless the response contract becomes unreachable, a token limit is reached, or an accepted output exceeds the 30 percent normalized word-edit boundary.
Run only after repeat one meets the pragmatic quality and contract gates; evaluate the same requirements over both repeats and independently in repeat two.

evaluation_policy.rationale: The raw transcript remains available and enhancement is optional. Promotion requires material aggregate restoration, while numbers, dates, names, negation, and technical terms still receive explicit semantic review.

irreversible_early_stop.mechanical: Stop once accepted requests plus every remaining request in the active gate cannot reach its minimum.
irreversible_early_stop.token_limit: Stop after the first token-limit failure.
irreversible_early_stop.gross_edit: Stop after the first mechanically accepted target above the 30 percent normalized word-edit boundary.
irreversible_early_stop.correct_input_regression: Record and continue; inspect severity after the full repeat.

cost_policy.conservative_input_accounting: Count each rendered Unicode code point as one input token for the hard planning envelope; this deliberately overstates normal tokenizer usage.

decision_rule: Run repeat two only if repeat one achieves at least five percent aggregate relative WER reduction, more improvements than regressions, and no hard contract or gross-edit failure. Compare the two-repeat result and semantic regressions directly with the frozen DeepSeek V4 Flash and GPT-5.6 Sol evidence.
claim_limit: This is a selected synthetic development challenge. It compares one postprocessing challenger but cannot estimate product quality, rank raw STT engines, or replace held-out human professional-audio evidence.
